38 mm black cotton webbing, cut at 1.26 m (no Sage code on the trims list).
mfg: Fold pocket in half, wrong sides together. Stitch a holding row all round the pocket at 5 mm. Press the pocket mitre and mark the centre of the pocket.
Press apron in half. Using the notches press the fold for the pocket position and press the centre of the pocket.
Set the mitred pocket to the front, parallel to the sides (2 cm). Trim the seam allowance at the top corners. Set to the top panel only, not all the way through.
Twin needle all round the pocket. Set the OH label centrally to the width of the base of the pocket, its base caught by the top row of twin needle stitching.
Tack the side of the pocket to the apron, aligned to the notch at the side seam.
With right sides together join side seams and hem with a 1 cm seam, leaving an opening in the top to turn through. Twin needle the sides.
Set the stitch lines at the centre (use the marker): twin needle two rows each side of the label and across the top and bottom of the label.

Mark the webbing at 32 cm and set the OH care label and product label. Mark at 28 cm from the end for the strap position on the apron, right side as worn. Fold the top edge of the apron over 1 cm to neaten and set the top of the apron 1.5 cm below the top of the webbing; twin needle across the top.
Set the outer part of the buckle to the shorter length of webbing: thread through 4 cm, turn the end under 1 cm and stitch down with two rows 5 mm apart.
Set the quick release part of the buckle to the longer length: grooved side underneath, thread the webbing through, fold the end back 1 cm, turn 2.5 cm and stitch down.
fin: Set the rivets: 8 at the top of the pocket openings and 4 at the top of the apron to the belt, 12 in all. Rivets at each side of the mitred pocket go through the pocket only, not through to the back.
Check, trim, press and fold in tissue. Product sticker to the bottom right-hand corner of the tissue.
